brief:
Sliman Mansour, a prominent Palestinian artist whose work became a symbol of struggle and resistance, has died at age 79, Al Jazeera English reported. The painter and printmaker was known for work that engaged directly with Palestinian political experience and social themes across a career spanning decades.

Mansour's artistic output shaped Palestinian visual culture and became central to how the Palestinian community expressed collective identity through creative work. His pieces addressed displacement, occupation, and daily life under Israeli rule, establishing him as a defining voice in Palestinian contemporary art.

title: Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour dies at 79
